title: Correct acceleration for B
description: Essential Criteria: The answer for part (1) must be 0.24 cm/s².

title: Correct acceleration for C
description: Essential Criteria: The answer for part (2) must be 0.04 cm/s².

title: Uses common linear velocity
description: Important Criteria: The solution must state or correctly apply that points A and B have the same linear speed because the rollers roll without slipping.

title: Applies centripetal formula
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly apply the formula a = v²/r or a = ω²r for the relevant points.

title: Relates radii correctly
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly use the given relationship R = 2r to connect the accelerations of A and B.

title: Uses common angular velocity
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), the solution must state or correctly apply that points A and C have the same angular velocity because they are on the same rigid roller.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The final answers should have the correct units (cm/s²) and be consistent with the given data.

title: Confuses linear and angular
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student incorrectly assumes the same angular velocity for A and B, or the same linear velocity for A and C.

title: Algebraic or arithmetic error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize for incorrect manipulation of ratios (e.g., a_B = a_A/2 instead of a_B = 2a_A) or basic arithmetic mistakes.
